team.name: Team 313
team.description: A team of students who love technology and keep learning for a better tomorrow.

members.name: Joannes Paulus M. Ople
members.bio: Specializes in data visualization, web development, and analytics.

projects.name: Learn Lab Power 2025: Soft Power Beyond AI
projects.description: Created 'Siam Pose,' an AI-interactive photo booth that uses Interactive Pose Matching and AI Virtual Clothes Changing to make Likay traditional Thai culture more accessible. The competition focused on elevating Thai soft power.

projects.name: BU Mini Hackathon 2026
projects.description: Selected for the Applications for Innovation & Sustainability business plan competition. The team developed sustainable, technology-enabled solutions and presented a business plan balancing technical feasibility with market viability.

projects.name: Automation Robot & AI Competition 2026
projects.description: Competed in the Automated Goods Sorting with AI and RoboticArm theme. The team programmed an automated robotic arm to inspect, classify, and sort items in a 20-minute live challenge, representing Bangkok University among more than 40 groups nationwide.

members.name: Yadawadee
members.bio: Designed the team website and works on machine learning, data analysis, and AI solutions, with experience in route optimization, financial prediction, and SME financial inclusion challenges.

projects.name: AI Hackathon: Route Optimization 2026
projects.description: Developed an AI-driven route optimization solution for an SCG CPAC logistics challenge, applying data-driven optimization to improve routing efficiency and support sustainable logistics.

projects.name: AI Hack Thailand 2025 (AI × Financial Data)
projects.description: Developed a machine learning model to predict Long Overdue Debtors using credit data from AIRA & AIFUL Public Company Limited. Used AUC as the primary evaluation metric and applied data preprocessing, exploratory data analysis, feature engineering, model selection, cross-validation, and hyperparameter tuning.

projects.name: SME Financial Inclusion Hackathon 2025
projects.description: Worked with a team on barriers SMEs face when accessing financial services and explored data-informed ways to improve financial inclusion.

members.name: Nattamon T.
members.bio: Works on market analysis, investment planning, financial feasibility, and sustainable transport concepts.

projects.name: Thailand Real Estate Case Competition 2025
projects.description: Developed a strategic real estate proposal for a Bangkok CBD site based on the CBRE case challenge, combining site and market analysis, development planning, financial feasibility, sustainability considerations, and an investment strategy.

projects.name: SAS Hackathon
projects.description: Created a blueprint for an electric cargo vessel and simulated energy use and trade-route logistics to consider battery lifecycle, payload capacity, commercial viability, and maritime environmental requirements.
